info.name: Chula Fondue API
info.description: Every API Gateway endpoint with assertions. Run the whole collection in order (Runner or newman); each run creates its own reporter, staff, department and tickets. See postman/README.md.

exec: pm.test('gateway reachable at ' + pm.environment.get('baseUrl') + ' (wrong environment or system not running?)', () => pm.expect.fail('no answer; run stopped'));

if (pm.response.code !== 200) { pm.test('admin login works (check adminEmail / adminPassword in the environment)', () => pm.expect.fail('login failed; run stopped')); (pm.execution && pm.execution.setNextRequest) ? pm.execution.setNextRequest(null) : postman.setNextRequest(null); return; }

pm.test('STAFF in department, active', () => { pm.expect(body.role).to.eql('STAFF'); pm.expect(body.departmentId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('deptId')); pm.expect(body.active).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 03b Accounts: sessions, password and access
Change password with wrong current password -> 401
Old token is revoked after password change -> 401

exec: pm.test('does not reveal whether the account exists', () => pm.expect(body.message).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('forgotMessage')));

item.name: Reset password with an unknown token -> 400
Reset password with a malformed token -> 400

item.description: Tokens carry a version; changing password, logging out, or an admin changing role/department/active state revokes old tokens on the next request.

exec: const it = body.find(r => r.category === 'IT / Network' && r.enabled);

request.description: Disabled, so it never competes with the demo rules (only one ENABLED rule per category is allowed).

item.name: 05 Ticket lifecycle (report -> assign -> start -> resolve -> reopen -> resolve -> confirm)

request.description: Category "Other" has no routing rule, so the ticket waits for the admin (manual assignment).

exec: pm.test('every transition in order', () => pm.expect(body.history.map(h => h.toStatus).filter((s, i, all) => s !== all[i - 1])).to.eql(['SUBMITTED', 'ASSIGNED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'RESOLVED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'RESOLVED', 'CLOSED']));

item.name: 05b Idempotent submission (Idempotency-Key)
Same key + same content -> same ticket (no duplicate)

item.description: A retried submission (double click, flaky network) must not create a second ticket.

exec: pm.test('contains B, only REJECTED', () => { pm.expect(body.tickets.map(t => t.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('ticketB')); body.tickets.forEach(t => pm.expect(t.status).to.eql('REJECTED')); });

item.name: 07 Guest token

request.description: Since commit c1e7997 only registered reporters may submit tickets.

item.name: Guest cannot read someone else's ticket -> 403

item.description: Guest tokens are still issued (POST /auth/guest) but can no longer create or read tickets.
